headline: Proposed Ordinance Amendment ZA-27-03 on Natural Communities, RTE Species, and Specimen Trees; discussion of homeownership and perpetual affordability with Champlain Housing Trust.
summary: The meeting covers a proposed ordinance amendment on natural communities, RTE species, and specimen trees. It also includes a discussion of homeownership and perpetual affordability, a staff report on E-motos, and a plan for a vegetation ordinance amendment under BCO Chapter 29.
